item.title: How the Philippines can leverage its Asean chairship to meet climate goals
item.description: Finalising ambitious climate targets, being self-reliant for climate funding and striving to uphold human rights aspects of critical minerals are ways the new Asean chair can steer the region to meet low carbon ambitions.

item.title: How data centres can avoid becoming the next coal mines
item.description: The resistance to AI will come from the social disruption it will bring – and data centres will be where that backlash lands first. Investors in AI must ensure that its benefits are shared, harm is reduced, and value created locally.

item.title: South Korea opposition hits President Lee over air pollution remarks as fine dust blankets nation
item.description: The People Power Party says Lee Jae-myung’s comments during China visit were undermined by fresh PM2.5 and yellow sand alerts, highlighting the long-running and sensitive cross-border pollution dispute with Beijing.

item.title: World Bank's IFC appoints Asia Pacific regional vice president
item.description: Indian national Sarvesh Suri moves into the Singapore-based role, replacing Riccardo Puliti, who has moved to Dubai to run IFC's Middle East and Central Asia division.

item.title: What chief sustainability officers fear in 2026
item.description: From dwindling influence to grappling with policy delay, Eco-Business asked Asia's sustainability leaders what is likely to keep them awake at night in the year of the horse.

item.title: Strategic priorities for Asean's newest member
item.description: Membership of Asean brings Timor-Leste political visibility and economic opportunity, but also new exposure to disputes in a grouping where several members are wrestling with democratic backsliding.

item.title: Global power struggles over the ocean’s finite resources
item.description: As climate change and great-power rivalry intensify, oceans are emerging as a geopolitical frontier – testing whether diplomacy can manage rising tensions over shipping routes, seabed minerals and fishing grounds.

item.title: Laos enforces nationwide burn ban as air pollution worsens in dry season
item.description: Data from a monitoring group shows the capital Vientiane and other cities hit by high PM2.5 levels as government rolls out dry-season fire controls and aligns measures with Asean guidelines.

item.title: What next for the High Seas Treaty as it enters into force?
item.description: Here’s what you need to know about the first international agreement focused on protecting marine biodiversity in international waters.

item.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Board to roll out used cooking oil reference price to boost transparency, drive circularity
item.description: Plantation and commodities minister Noraini Ahmad said an official used cooking oil (UCO) benchmark will improve market transparency, guide fair trading, and support a more sustainable palm oil market.
